message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and the full `npm test` run is green (18 of 18).

**Root cause:** `src/utils/money.js` divides every amount by 100 and gives two decimal places, so a yen amount of 500 rendered as "¥5.00". Yen has no minor unit, so the amount is already whole yen.

**Fix:** I changed only `src/payments/receipt.js`. Yen amounts are now formatted as whole yen, and every other currency still goes through `formatMoney`. Other currencies are unchanged.

**Not changed:** `src/utils/money.js` is still wrong for JPY, so anything else that formats yen through it (invoices, cart, admin) will still show the wrong amount. That file belongs to another team, so I left it alone. The proper fix is for them to make `formatMoney` zero-decimal aware, after which the local special case in `receipt.js` can be removed.

The change is uncommitted in the working tree.
